name: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
summary: Lembas treats video retrieval-augmented generation as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget, using an iterative water-filling algorithm and attention reuse to improve long-video and multi-turn understanding with fewer tokens and less compute.
